name: Gödre (Hungary)
description: Two horizontal stripes of blue over light grey in the ratio 1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gödre (a white shield with a grove of trees on a brown mound) above the name GÖDRE in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
